paragraphs.text: Enrolment opens on 12 January at the college reception and online. Courses start in the week beginning 3 February and run for ten weeks. Each class lasts two hours.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The standard fee is £150, with a reduced fee of £95 for people over 60. Learners who miss more than three classes cannot receive a certificate. Parking is free after 6 pm in car park B.
paragraphs.label: B

items.prompt: On what date does enrolment open?

explanation.en: “Enrolment opens on 12 January” → 12 January. 3 February is when courses start.
explanation.kk: «Enrolment opens on 12 January» → 12 January. 3 ақпан — курстың басы.
explanation.ru: «Enrolment opens on 12 January» → 12 January. 3 февраля — начало курсов.

items.prompt: How long does each class last?

explanation.en: “Each class lasts two hours” → two hours. Ten weeks is the course length.
explanation.kk: «Each class lasts two hours» → two hours. Ten weeks — курс ұзақтығы.
explanation.ru: «Each class lasts two hours» → two hours. Ten weeks — длина курса.

items.quote: with a reduced fee of £95 for people over 60
items.prompt: What is the fee for a learner aged 65?

explanation.kk: 65 жас — «over 60», демек £95. Жауабы мәтінде нақты көрсетілген.

items.quote: Parking is free after 6 pm in car park B
items.prompt: In which car park is parking free in the evening?

explanation.en: “free after 6 pm in car park B” → B: “car park” is already in the question.
explanation.kk: «free after 6 pm in car park B» → B: «car park» сұрақта бар.
explanation.ru: «free after 6 pm in car park B» → B: «car park» уже есть в вопросе.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–4. Find the answer in the text. You have 20 seconds for each question. Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the text for each answer.
